scope: Android Muse features relevant to the Portal backlog; not a parity promise

evidence_rules.runtime_reported: The existing Muse reports access; delivery/export still needs verification
evidence_rules.source_verified: A specific source implements this capability on its documented platform
evidence_rules.portal_verified: Implemented and tested on this Portal; distinguish local tests from live acceptance
evidence_rules.unknown: Asked, not established; do not claim this is available or unavailable

features.source_evidence: Merged PR17 implements inline JPEG/PNG/WebP and Android decoding checks. PR10 implements a separate bounded display.draw_url command. Actual main-context export/invocation acceptance remains deployment-specific.

features.design_constraint: Addressed canonical reads accept text/voice only; replies to local photos still need native parent links.
An isolated viewer is required; no privileged JavaScript bridge or arbitrary local-file access. Do not publish private artifacts merely to make them fetchable.
User actions must bind to fixed server-side actions; do not accept arbitrary executable callbacks.

features.source_evidence: Merged PR16 connects the PR14 component; exact-label taps are fresh silent text inputs.
Merged PR8 improves local TTS; PR17 adds MP3 export playback bound to a local voice input. This does not establish the phone conversational voice or actual main-context end-to-end export.
Kotlin text request builder accepts session_id, but app does not yet select or subscribe to a chosen thread.

features.design_constraint: Separate opt-in visual route; never grants audio permission or imports private history.

features.source_evidence: Merged PR15 integrates PR13. Model assets require explicit preparation. Real room acoustic and owner interaction acceptance are distinct from offline tests.

features.design_constraint: A Portal microphone event does not identify the speaker; do not silently collect biometric samples.

source_note: Existing Muse runtime capability report received October 11, 2026. Self-reported use is explicitly distinguished from an independently verified Portal delivery.
context_review: Existing Muse reaffirmed its main-turn device/file metadata report and favored a canonical-input request tool. Main-context-invoked action results are observed; an unsolicited push trigger is only proposed. A conflicting broadcast has disputed authorship, so its extra capabilities are excluded pending direct verification. Never treat shared transport credentials as proof of main-context composition.
implementation_policy: This inventory scopes backlog items. It does not activate microphones, biometrics, new providers, permissions, rendering, or a replacement Muse.
